requirement.statement: The runtime SHALL expose a transport-neutral DomainOperationExecutionError for trusted handlers to carry one or more structured OperationDiagnostic facts; atomic execution SHALL preserve their code, category, severity, and path while rolling back writes, and best-effort scheduling SHALL retain the diagnostic identity while remapping a singleton handler item path to the original batch item index.

case.given: a trusted handler writes inside an atomic transaction and then throws a structured domain diagnostic
case.when: the runtime builds the failure response
case.then: the write SHALL roll back, mutation facts SHALL be empty, before and after probes SHALL match, and the supplied diagnostic code and path SHALL remain unchanged

case.given: a best-effort batch singleton handler throws one or more structured diagnostics for its local item zero
case.when: the scheduler maps the failure to the original request
case.then: every diagnostic code SHALL remain unchanged, every path SHALL identify the original batch item index, and the item mapping SHALL reference all corresponding response diagnostic paths
